data.description: 【艾雅法拉 · 火山口边缘】翻滚着刺鼻硫磺气体的活火山口断崖边缘，艾雅法拉蹲在滚烫的岩壁旁小心翼翼地用小铁铲采集凝固岩浆样本。微风吹动她毛茸茸的羊耳，她回头向你露出安心的微笑——「前辈请站在安全线后面！有小黑和小白保护我，采集工作马上就结束了哦！」
data.promptProse: Eyjafjalla crouches beside the crater's scorching rock wall and scrapes solidified magma into a small iron scoop, sheep ears stirring as she looks reassuringly back from beyond the safety line. Research coat, white blouse and black skirt remain in the wide view against the vast rim. Harsh volcanic light catches scoop and fractured rock, while rising steam diffuses the glow and heat shimmer bends the farther crater planes into wavering layers.
data.title: 艾雅法拉 · 火山口边缘
